Screenshots

The whole app, one screen at a time.

Click a picture to see it full size; the arrow keys move between them.

The watch in most of these pictures is “Chronograph Watch Mudmaster” by graphiccompressor (Sketchfab), prepared by Darmstadt Graphics Group for the Khronos glTF Sample Assets and used under CC BY 4.0. In several pictures it has been changed by the app’s own tools, as the captions say. The bolts, nuts, washers and gears come from the app’s library.

Run it on your own machine.

Free and open source under the MIT licence. Windows and macOS; your files never leave the computer.
